## Issue outcome

For issue #69 (bug: activity-log prefetch guard checks X-Inertia-Prefetch, but Inertia sends Purpose: prefetch), requests marked by Inertia with `Purpose: prefetch` must not create `session_viewed`, `announcement_viewed`, or `calendar_viewed` events. Ordinary navigation must continue to create one event.

## Verified implementation facts

- The application uses Laravel 13.26.1, PHP 8.5.9, Inertia React, and the existing controller-based route design.
- `package-lock.json` and the installed dependency tree resolve `@inertiajs/core` 3.7.0.
- The installed client sets `visit.headers["Purpose"] = "prefetch"` in `application/source/node_modules/@inertiajs/core/dist/index.js` at line 3552.
- `LearningSessionController`, `AnnouncementController`, and `CalendarController` currently skip logging only when `X-Inertia-Prefetch` is present.
- `UserActivityTest.php` sends `X-Inertia-Prefetch`; it does not test the header the installed client sends.
- `application/ops/activity-logging.md` says view events exclude Inertia prefetches, but does not name the actual header.

## Bounded design

Keep the existing Laravel application, controllers, activity model, table, routes, authorization, and event names. In each of the three controller guards, suppress only the view event when the `Purpose` request header equals `prefetch`; do not suppress the page response or alter access checks. Preserve the event write for ordinary navigation.

Update the existing feature tests to send `Purpose: prefetch` for sessions, announcements, and calendar, assert no matching event for each, then verify ordinary navigation records exactly one event. Keep denied-request and existing activity tests. Update the operations note to name the verified header.

Do not add a migration, new provider, shared framework layer, new event type, historical-log cleanup, or changes for the separate Q&A redirect finding in issue #68 (bug: every Q&A action also logs a session_viewed (redirect back to the session page)).

## Verification and rollback

- Focused: `php artisan test --filter=UserActivityTest`.
- Full PHP: `php artisan test`.
- Frontend/static checks: `composer run lint:check`, `npm run lint:check`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run types:check`, and `npm run build`.
- Repository check: `git diff --check`.
- Rollback: revert only the three guard, feature-test, and operations-note changes. No schema or stored activity rows are changed.
- Safe screenshot: the plan requires a local administrator activity-log screenshot with synthetic `.test` data at `evidence/activity-log-prefetch-exclusion.png`. Playwright with a cached Chromium headless shell is available; screenshot capture remains Build evidence.
